title: manifest: add intent filter to handle search.fdroid.org links
description:
Feature #3362. When a user clicks a link to https://search.fdroid.org/?q=gallery from any app (chat, browser, email), F-Droid now offers itself as a handler. Clicking opens the Search screen.

## What this MR does

- Adds an intent filter in AndroidManifest.xml for the search.fdroid.org host with utoVerify=true, so once the website hosts ssetlinks.json (the same way  -droid.org already does for the packages/ deep links), the link opens F-Droid automatically without a chooser dialog. Until then, the user gets a chooser with F-Droid listed.
- Updates IntentRouter.kt to detect https://search.fdroid.org/... URLs and navigate to the Search screen.

## What this MR does NOT do (intentional)

Pre-filling the search box with the q query parameter requires changing NavigationKey.Search from a data object to a data class with an initialQuery field. That touches NavigationKey.kt, Main.kt, MyAppsViewModel.kt, MyApps.kt, and IntentRouter.kt, and the == comparison in Main.kt:148 would need to be updated to use is NavigationKey.Search instead. That refactor is left for a follow-up MR to keep this one minimal and reviewable.

For now, the IntentRouter logs the incoming q parameter so we can verify which queries users are actually sending once this ships. Pre-fill can be added later without changing the manifest.
